build_model_loader: build a model loader instance using get_model_loader with a specified LoadConfig and ModelConfig
create_default_model_loader: create a DefaultModelLoader that loads model weights from disk in multiple formats including safetensors and GGUF
test_get_weights_iterator: test the DefaultModelLoader._get_weights_iterator to iterate over model weights from HuggingFace or local paths
save_sharded_state: save a PyTorch model's state dict into sharded safetensors files using ShardedStateLoader.save_model
save_remote_model: save a model's weights and config files to a remote storage backend using RemoteModelLoader.save_model
